# Execution evidence contract (issue #504).
# Record the actual action execution platform, not only the Bazel client
# or CI runner OS. Run resulting artifacts on matching native target
# workers; cross-building alone is insufficient. Emulation, Rosetta,
# remote execution and deployment-floor testing are distinct evidence.
# Inspected upstream CI uses remote execution in Linux jobs with narrower
# macOS smoke and coverage tests; the Windows-labelled lane builds remote
# GNULVM targets, not native MSVC tests or coverage.
